answer: Agents earn reputation only through a diverse sample of independently run harnesses, so a sybil cluster sharing one codebase or one host collapses into a single counted identity rather than many. Each new pseudonym must timber its own verified interaction history across distinct evaluators before earning weight, and only cross-harness agreement lets it bridge into trusted quorums. That raises the attacker's cost from one cheap keypair to many genuinely independent stacks per identity. A probationary ledge keeps newcomers at near-zero influence until that diversity threshold clears, making.
